paragraphs.text: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles ( TMNT ; stylized as Magic: The Gathering® | Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles ) is a Magic: The Gathering expansion in the Universes Beyond series, based on the multimedia franchise of the same name . It was released on March 6, 2026 featuring characters and stories from the entire franchise. The set was first announced at New York Comic Con 2025 but was accidentally spoiled two days prior when a TMNT-themed food truck bearing the Magic: The Gathering logo was seen around the convention venue. The set is Standard legal and is the 110th Magic expansion. The set was designed with Pick-Two Draft (4-player draft) in mind.

The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (TMNT) is an American multimedia franchise created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird and currently owned by Viacom ( Paramount Skydance ). It originated as a comic book series published by Mirage Studios in 1984 and has since expanded into a global phenomenon encompassing television, film, toys, video games, merchandise, and more. The franchise centers around four anthropomorphic turtle brothers— Leonardo , Donatello , Michelangelo , and Raphael —trained in ninjitsu by their rat sensei, Splinter , as they fight crime and face a rogues' gallery of villains, most notably the Shredder and the Foot Clan . They live in New York City, residing in the sewers. They fight evil and, in their spare time, enjoy doing teenager things like skateboarding, playing video games, and eating pizza. Each turtle has a theme true to the character. Leonardo is about sneak and being a ninja , Donatello is about artifacts , Raphael is about attacking and dealing damage to opponents, and Michelangelo is about Food and Mutagen and +1/+1 counters .

For the set, R&D could draw from most of the various incarnations of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise. Unlike many other Universes Beyond properties, though, there's no single canon source. Every version of TMNT tells its own take on the story.

The partnership between Magic and Nickelodeon (the broadcaster of the animated series) was revealed at MagicCon Atlanta 2025, though the specifics of the set were deliberately saved for New York Comic Con two weeks later. Fans quickly speculated that the set would be the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, based on the NYCC panel members.

During the Lorwyn Eclipsed prerelease events, many players found their prerelease packs contained foil promo cards from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles , instead of the intended Lorwyn Eclipsed promos. Although not a widespread issue, enough cards were found that almost all rares and mythic rares for the set were spoiled two months before their intended release. In response, Wizards of the Coast announced that this was not intentional and that, where possible, stores should try to replace the TMNT promos with Lorwyn Eclipsed promos. They also updated the official card gallery to include all rares and mythic rares from the main set. To make up for the mistake, participants in TMNT prerelease received a promo pack from an older Standard set as an extra.
The main Standard -legal set uses the code TMT. Alternate card frames have a different card number than the original version.
The related non-Standard code is TMC ( TMNT Commander); these cards are legal in Commander , Legacy , and Vintage , and reprints remain legal where already legal.

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles features 195 regular cards (67 commons, 55 uncommons, 53 rares, 15 mythic rares, 5 basic lands) . It became available in Play Boosters , Collector Boosters , one Commander deck , the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Bundle , a " specialty " Pizza Bundle, a Draft Night Box, and the Turtle Team-Up Box.

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Play Boosters contain 14 playing cards and 1 non-foil double-sided token . A Play Booster box contains 30 packs. Collector Boosters contain 15 cards plus 1 art card or traditional-foil double-sided token. A Collector Booster box contains 12 packs. All cards opened in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Play Boosters are legal in Draft and Sealed , including the PZA Source Material cards . There is a "Turtle slot" in each Play Booster. TMNT introduced the Sneak mechanic. Sneak represents an alternate cost for spells that can be paid during the declare blockers step by returning an unblocked attacking creature you control to your hand. When creatures are cast for their sneak cost, they enter tapped and attacking. Sneak is very similar to ninjutsu , but plays in a new design space by being a cost instead of an ability. Most notably, noncreature spells can have sneak costs.

The set also introduced the Disappear ability word . Disappear is revolt with a different name; it signifies abilities that only work if a permanent has left the battlefield under your control in the same turn. Most disappear abilities in the set trigger on their controller's end step, but a few are enters triggers on creatures.

Alliance returned from Streets of New Capenna , representing the camaraderie between the Turtles and their allies. It triggers an effect whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control.
Enrage and Channel appeared as cameos .

TMNT introduced the Utrom creature type . It also introduces the predefined Mutagen token. Mutagens are artifacts with " , , Sacrifice this token: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery."
A cycle of Classes is used to represent the roles that each of the Turtles and Splinter plays in their group.
Like Marvel's Spider-Man , the set features legendary creatures at common to increase the likelihood that players will open cards featuring the set's iconic characters.
TMNT makes extensive use of +1/+1 counters .
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, a Pick-Two Draft set, features five major limited archetypes . It is enemy-color based, contrasting to Marvel's Spider-Man , which was allied-color based.

Writing for Polygon shortly after the set was fully spoiled, Francesco Cacciatore opined that expectations that the set would attract new players to Magic were misguided, saying that the IP derived most of its appeal from nostalgia, and the lore and mechanics would not be as independently attractive as those of Final Fantasy and Avatar: The Last Airbender . He also noted widespread criticism of the set's art among fans online.
The focus of the Commander deck on the TMNT video games led Phil Hornshaw of Gamespot to dub Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles "The Most Video Gamey Set Ever".

Sewer-veillance Cam is a fairly efficient engine to untap one's own creatures with low opportunity cost to include in a deck. This became problematic in Alchemy thanks to its synergy with A-Vivi Ornitier , the rebalanced version of a powerful Final Fantasy creature. In Alchemy, Vivi's mana-producing ability costs , a change made to weaken its combo with Agatha's Soul Cauldron but which inadvertently made it a very rewarding untap target. Combined with Boomerang Basics , this deck could massively accelerate its mana in a single turn while keeping its hand full. To tone down Vivi's dominance on the Alchemy ladder, Sewer-veillance Cam was banned from the format on May 18, 2026.
